road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: rank
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: national rank among all 1,827,550 scored segments by blackspot_score, highest first; ties broken by segment_id ascending. Gaps occur because only some segments are exported

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: segment_id
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: segment identifier: <road number or class>-<first 12 hex characters of the first OS Open Roads link identifier>-<piece, at least 2 digits>. Unique in the file

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: location
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: display label: road (name) from-to km of stretch run

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: road_id
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: road number (e.g. A23, A1(M), M6 TOLL), or the road class letter C, U or N for unnumbered roads

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: km_from
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: start of the segment along its junction-to-junction stretch (not a milepost)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: km_to
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: end of the segment along its stretch

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: lat
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: segment midpoint latitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326), converted from the BNG midpoint; CSV keeps 6 significant digits (about 10 m)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: lon
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: segment midpoint longitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: blackspot_score
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: PRIMARY SCORE. Expected killed-or-seriously-injured casualties (DfT severity-adjusted) on this segment over 2026 and 2027 combined, forecast by the frozen LightGBM (Poisson) from 2023-25 history. A burden, not a per-vehicle risk. CSV keeps 6 significant digits; order by rank, never by this rounded value

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: n_crashes
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: injury collisions snapped to this segment, all severities

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: n_ksi
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: collisions whose STATS19 collision_severity is fatal or serious (reported, not adjusted)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: n_fatal
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: fatal collisions

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: ksi_rate
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: n_ksi / n_crashes

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: crashes_per_year
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: n_crashes / 3

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: speed_max
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: highest speed limit recorded at this segment's collisions

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: pct_night
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: share of collisions between 22:00 and 05:59

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: pct_junction
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: v1 definition kept for compatibility: share with junction_detail != 0. Missing and unknown codes count as junction, and 2024-format roundabouts as non-junction. Use pct_junction_v2

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: future_ksi
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: always empty: the forecast period has not happened

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: future_fatal
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: always empty

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: run
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: stretch ordinal within road_id, for drawing a road in order only; not a risk feature

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: score_version
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: output version

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: score_model
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: model behind blackspot_score

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: score_definition
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: plain-text definition of blackspot_score

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: forecast_period
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: years the score forecasts

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: history_period
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: years the history columns and model inputs cover

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: road_class
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: OS Open Roads class by majority length: M motorway, A, B, C classified unnumbered, U unclassified, N not classified

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: road_number
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: road number

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: road_name
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: road name

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: form_of_way
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: OS Open Roads formOfWay by majority length

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: length_m
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: planar length of the segment centreline in British National Grid

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: os_first_link_id
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: OS Open Roads RoadLink identifier of the segment's first link: a geometry reference into OS data

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: piece
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: piece index within the stroke (0-based); the last part of segment_id

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: pct_junction_v2
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: share of collisions at a junction: junction_detail in {13, 16, 17, 18, 19} (DfT 2024 coding) or road_type = roundabout

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: n_ksi_casualties
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: killed or seriously injured casualties as reported

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: n_ksi_casualties_adjusted
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: KSI casualties on DfT's severity-adjusted scale (fatal + adjusted serious probability); the scale of the target

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: eb_expected_ksi
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: Empirical Bayes benchmark forecast (not the production score): EB estimate of history KSI x k, where k is the history-to-target scale estimated on the training pair
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.units: expected adjusted KSI casualties, 2-year total (2026-27 forecast)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: spf_expected_ksi_history
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: KSI expected on similar roads (NB2 safety performance function on road attributes; no crash history, no traffic)
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.units: expected adjusted KSI casualties, 2023-25 history window

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: eb_ksi_history
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: EB estimate of this segment's KSI over the history window (weighted mix of SPF and observed)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: eb_excess_ksi_history
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: eb_ksi_history - spf_expected_ksi_history: KSI above similar roads. Can be negative. A screening signal, not a cause

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: eb_weight
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: EB weight on the SPF prior, 1 / (1 + alpha x SPF)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: aadf
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: mean annual average daily flow, all motor vehicles, at the matched DfT count point over 2023-25

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: aadf_count_point
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: DfT count_point_id used for aadf (stored as a float-formatted number in the CSV)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: aadf_share_counted
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: share of the count point's 2023-25 AADF years that were counted, not estimated, by DfT

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: exposure_available
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: true when a same-number DfT count point matched the segment (motorway and A roads only)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: vehicle_km_history
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: aadf x 365 x 3 x length_m / 1000

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: ksi_per_100m_vkm_eb
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: EB-smoothed adjusted KSI per 100 million vehicle-km over the history window (exposure SPF), a per-vehicle risk rate, separate from blackspot_score. Do not display below 250 m length
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.units: adjusted KSI per 100 million vehicle-km, 2023-25 history window

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: eb_excess_ksi_exposure
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: EB KSI minus the exposure-SPF expectation (similar roads with similar traffic). Can be negative

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: data_sufficiency
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: sufficient: >= 6 collisions; sparse: 1-5; none: 0. Scores for sparse/none lean on road type and neighbours

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: max_single_collision_ksi
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: largest adjusted KSI from any one collision on the segment (0 when none)

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: single_event_share
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: max_single_collision_ksi / n_ksi_casualties_adjusted

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: single_event_flag
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: true when one collision supplied >= 5 adjusted KSI and >= 50% of the segment's history KSI (mass-casualty events). Post-hoc annotation; changes no score

road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.name: spatial_block
road_segments_ranked_v2.csv.meaning: 50 km British National Grid square used for spatial validation: floor(E/50000) x 1000 + floor(N/50000). Not an administrative area

extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.name: segment_id
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.meaning: join key to the base CSV

extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.name: rank
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.meaning: production rank, copied from the base CSV

extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.name: contrib_rank
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.meaning: 1 = largest absolute attribution for this segment

extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.name: feature
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.meaning: model input name (one of the 45 production features)

extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.name: feature_value
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.meaning: raw model input value (log_length is log metres; shares 0-1)
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.null_when: the model input is missing (e.g. history descriptors with no collisions)

extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.name: shap_log
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.meaning: TreeSHAP attribution in log expected KSI (production model)

extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.name: factor
extensions/segment_explanations_v2.csv.meaning: exp(shap_log): multiplies the model baseline; an attribution, not a causal effect

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: rank_median
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: median national rank across 20 spatial-block bootstrap refits

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: rank_iqr
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: interquartile range of the refit ranks

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: freq_top100
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: share of the 20 refits ranking the segment in the national top 100 (5% steps)

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: freq_top1000
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: share of refits in the top 1,000

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: freq_top5pct
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: share of refits in the top 5% (91,377)

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: freq_top10pct
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: share of refits in the top 10%

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: freq_top20pct
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: share of refits in the top 20%

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: stability_class
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: robust top-1000: >= 90% of refits in the top 1,000; borderline top-1000: 50-90%; robust top-5%: otherwise in the top 5% in >= 90%; variable: the rest

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: window_rank_min
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: best rank across the 12 historical-window rankings

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: window_rank_max
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: worst rank across the 12 historical-window rankings

extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.name: rank_without_largest_collision
extensions/segment_stability_v2.csv.meaning: SIMULTANEOUS definition: national rank when every top-1,000 segment loses its own largest 2023-25 collision at once. For 'how much does this one collision matter' use segment_single_event_sensitivity_v2.csv

extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.name: forecast_without_largest_collision
extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.meaning: the production model's forecast with the segment's largest 2023-25 collision (by adjusted KSI) removed from its own history features; road and context unchanged; no refit. Can be HIGHER than forecast (non-monotone model)

extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.name: rank_without_largest_collision_one_at_a_time
extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.meaning: national rank if only this segment changed; use this for per-segment wording

extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.name: rank_without_largest_collision_simultaneous
extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.meaning: national rank when all top-1,000 segments change at once (equals rank_without_largest_collision in the stability file)

extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.name: largest_collision_adj_ksi
extensions/segment_single_event_sensitiv.meaning: adjusted KSI of the removed collision
